caveats: Students MUST take the following courses prior to enrollment into the major
OCES 4964 OR (OCES 4974 AND OCES 4984) OR (SCIE 3500 AND SCIE 4500) -- (Students following IRE Track can only use (SCIE 3500 AND SCIE 4500) to fulfill the requirement.)
Students with level 3 or above in HKDSE 1x Biology are exempted from taking LIFS 1901 -- an exemption, not a requirement; it is not applied automatically.
LANG 4010 -- (Students following IRE Track are exempted from this course and should take LANG 3027 to fulfill the IRE requirement.)
Requirements: COMP 1022P is named in the requirement PDF but not in the 2026-27 course catalog, so it was left out of this check.
